title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Elon study environments spanning quiet rooms, library seating, collaborative commons and project-friendly workspaces. Confirm building access and room availability before visiting.

cards.title: Settle In at Belk Library
cards.subtitle: Individual carrels, group rooms and research support
cards.notes: Choose a carrel for solo work or ask library staff about an available group room; check the library’s live hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A central library with individual and collaborative study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon identifies Belk Library as a place to research, study and collaborate; university history documents study carrels, tables and study rooms.
cards.source_title: About Us | Carol Grotnes Belk Library | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Belk serves Elon students, faculty, staff, alumni and community learners. Consult the library’s current hours page; room reservation rules were not stated on the cited page.

cards.title: Match the Seat to the Assignment
cards.subtitle: Movable furniture, private rooms and collaborative sites
cards.notes: Use a booth or easy chair for reading, then shift to a movable table when the assignment calls for conversation or shared materials.
cards.short_summary: A bright learning commons designed for both focused and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Koenigsberger Learning Center contains private study spaces, collaborative engagement sites and varied seating, including high-top tables, booths and easy chairs.
cards.source_title: KLC: Elon's newest learning hub | Today at Elon
cards.access_notes: Enter through the KLC entrance facing Inman Admissions or through Belk Library. Confirm current library hours and private-room availability.

cards.title: Take a Study Nook in LaRose
cards.subtitle: Historic Neighborhood study nooks and gathering space
cards.notes: Bring a compact reading or writing task to a study nook; confirm residential-area access before planning a group session here.
cards.short_summary: Neighborhood-scale study nooks inside a named student commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon states that LaRose Student Commons provides gathering and study space and includes dedicated study nooks.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Historic Neighborhood. The cited university page does not specify visitor access, operating hours or reservations; verify locally.

cards.entity_name: Ernest A. Koury Sr. Business Center
cards.title: Bring the Group to Koury
cards.subtitle: Study rooms, open work areas and computer labs
cards.notes: Use an open collaboration area for informal teamwork, or check locally whether a study room is available for a longer working session.
cards.short_summary: A business-school setting with rooms and open areas for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s current facilities page says Koury Business Center has study rooms, three computer labs and open areas designed for student-faculty collaboration.
cards.source_title: Facilities | M.S. in Accounting | Elon University
cards.access_notes: An academic building used by Love School of Business programs. The cited page does not state room reservations, hours or general visitor access.

cards.title: Work It Out on Sankey’s Walls
cards.subtitle: Breakout spaces with vertical writing surfaces
cards.notes: Bring markers only if the posted surface permits them, and use a breakout area to diagram a problem or organize a team presentation.
cards.short_summary: Project-friendly breakout space in a cross-disciplinary academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon documents study rooms, conference rooms and collaborative breakout spaces in Sankey Hall, whose design includes vertical writing surfaces.
cards.source_title: Facilities | M.S. in Accounting | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Sankey serves students across academic majors, but the cited page does not provide building hours or study-room reservation rules; confirm on site.

cards.title: Spread Out in Hunt Atrium
cards.subtitle: Tiered seating and open collaboration areas in Founders Hall
cards.notes: Choose the tiered benches for reading or informal teamwork, but check the event schedule because the atrium also hosts speakers and receptions.
cards.short_summary: An open engineering atrium suited to visible, informal collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon describes Hunt Atrium in Founders Hall as having open collaboration spaces, tiered bench seating and meeting space for group events.
cards.access_notes: The atrium doubles as an event venue. The cited page provides no daily hours or reservation policy; check for scheduled events before settling in.

cards.title: Find a Group Room in Innovation Hall
cards.subtitle: Study rooms within the Innovation Quad
cards.notes: Check whether a group room is open before unpacking, then use the surrounding interactive spaces when your work needs a larger footprint.
cards.short_summary: A STEM-centered building with rooms planned for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon states that Innovation Hall and Founders Hall opened in August 2022; the university’s Innovation Quad plan specifies group study rooms in Innovation Hall.
cards.source_title: Elon dedicates Founders Hall and Innovation Hall | Today at Elon
cards.access_notes: Home to engineering and physics programs. The cited current-building article does not publish hours or group-room reservation procedures.

cards.title: Use a Study Room at McCoy Commons
cards.subtitle: The Oaks lounge, study rooms and meeting space
cards.notes: Ask about access to a study room before meeting your group; use the lounge only when your work will not disrupt other residents.
cards.short_summary: A residential commons with documented rooms for study and meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon documents McCoy Commons as the activity center of The Oaks and says it contains a lounge, study rooms and meeting space.
cards.source_title: Commitment to students a focus of McCoy Commons dedication | Today at Elon
cards.access_notes: McCoy Commons is part of The Oaks residential area. Current access, hours and study-room reservation rules are not published on the cited page.

cards.title: Read in the Multifaith Center Library
cards.subtitle: Library and study rooms in a reflective campus setting
cards.notes: Use the library or a designated study room quietly, and yield spaces needed for worship, meditation, meetings or scheduled programs.
cards.short_summary: A multifaith facility combining a library with dedicated study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon states that Numen Lumen Pavilion contains study rooms, a library, prayer and meditation rooms and the McBride Gathering Space.
cards.source_title: A story of meaningful relationship: The Numen Lumen Pavilion celebrates 10 years | Today at Elon
cards.access_notes: This is an active multifaith center. Respect programmed religious use; the cited page does not provide current hours or study-room booking rules.

cards.title: Review Health Sciences Material at Francis
cards.subtitle: Student study spaces and an updated commons
cards.notes: Bring health-sciences coursework to a student study area, and confirm academic-building access before arranging a meeting with classmates.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated study areas inside Elon’s School of Health Sciences building.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon reports that renovations to the Gerald L. Francis Center added student study spaces and updated its commons area.
cards.source_title: An EcoVillage, a new commons and more in the works this summer at Elon | Today at Elon
cards.access_notes: The building houses the School of Health Sciences. The cited page does not publish current hours, general access rules or reservation requirements.

warnings: Current operating hours and reservation policies were not available on the cited facility pages for most locations; access_notes explicitly identify where users should verify locally.
Coordinates and direct map URLs were left null because exact destination-level values were not verified from the supporting sources.
